note: A channel's stated target level, converted into the move it implies, beside the share of historical windows that moved at least that far in the same direction. It does not say the claim is wrong - a 60th-percentile move is possible, it is just not insight. The value is in replacing 'soon' with a number.

cautions.not_a_verdict: A claim is not scored as right or wrong. Only the size of the move it requires is measured against history.
cautions.text_only: Only a target level written next to an index name is parsed. 'Market will rise' is skipped, not guessed at.
cautions.survivorship: The index history is the Nifty itself, so it carries no survivorship problem - but ten years is one regime, not all of them.
